heading: Mission & Vision

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To serve the people of Nellore district with honesty and dedication, strengthening Janasena  's grassroots presence and upholding the party's founding ideals of clean, accountable governance.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: A Nellore district and Andhra Pradesh where honest politics, social transformation and people-first governance define public life — in line with the Janasena movement's founding goals.

quote.text: The Janasena movement began with the goal of promoting honest politics and bringing about social change.

_note: Mission/vision text is drafted to align with Janasena  's publicly stated ideals; refine with Kishore's own wording from the source site.
